text: I have two hands but I cannot clap. What am I?
I follow you in the sun and vanish in the dark. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and answer when you call. What am I?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I have 88 keys and hammers inside, and I make music. What am I?
I have keys, a space bar and an enter key, but no door. What am I?
I get wetter the more I dry things. What am I?
I fall from the sky but I never get hurt. What am I?
I have a neck but no head. I hold your drink. What am I?
I have a bank but no money. I flow to the sea. What am I?
I have teeth but I never bite. I fix your hair. What am I?
You can catch me but you cannot throw me. What am I?
I have one eye but I cannot see. What am I?
I go up every year but never come down. What am I?
I have four legs but I cannot walk. You eat at me. What am I?
I am full of holes but I still hold water. What am I?
I have a head and a tail but no body. What am I?
I am tall when I am new and short when I am old. What am I?
I have a spine and many pages but no bones. What am I?
I have yellow wheels and carry children to school. What am I?
I have petals and I turn my face to the sun. What am I?
I am the building with the most stories. What am I?
I can fill a room but take up no space. What am I?
I have a trunk, big ears and a very long memory. What am I?
I carry my home on my back and move very slowly. What am I?
I sleep upside down in a cave and come out at night. What am I?
I have eight arms and live in the sea. What am I?
I have a long neck and spots and eat leaves from tall trees. What am I?
I wear black and white stripes and run on the savanna. What am I?
I have a pouch and I hop. What am I?
I glow in the garden on summer nights. What am I?
I spin a web to catch my dinner. What am I?
I buzz from flower to flower and make honey. What am I?
I cannot fly but I swim, and I wear a black and white suit. What am I?
I say hoot at night and turn my head far around. What am I?
I have a hump and walk across the desert. What am I?
I have a mane and a loud roar. What am I?
I swim on the pond and say quack. What am I?
I am green, I jump, and I say ribbit. What am I?
I fall in winter and no two of me are alike. What am I?
I am a bright arc in the sky after rain. What am I?
I am the loud boom that comes after lightning. What am I?
I am a ball of fire in the sky that gives light all day. What am I?
I change my shape each month and shine at night. What am I?
I twinkle at night far away. What am I?
I am a rocky traveler with a long tail of ice and dust. What am I?
I carry astronauts to space. What am I?
I wear a white suit with a helmet to walk in space. Who am I?
I turn the wind into power with big blades. What am I?
I have blades and I cool a hot room. What am I?
I show your face when you look at me. What am I?
I keep your drinks cold and hum all day. What am I?
I whistle when the water is hot. What am I?
I have four legs and a back but I am not an animal. What am I?
I cut paper with two blades that meet. What am I?
I write, and I have an eraser on my head. What am I?
I open above you when it rains. What am I?
I keep your feet warm and often lose my twin. What am I?
I have two wheels, a bell and pedals. What am I?
I float and carry people across the water. What am I?
I run on tracks and say choo-choo. What am I?
I have wings and carry travelers through the sky. What am I?
I have strings and a bow but no arrows. What am I?
I have strings and you strum me. What am I?
You hit me with sticks to keep the beat. What am I?
You blow into me and I make music through my pipe. What am I?
I have a slide and a loud sound. What am I?
I have three sides and three corners. What am I?
I have no corners and I roll. What am I?
I am the number of days in a week. What am I?
I am the season when the leaves turn orange and fall. What am I?
I float high in the sky and give you rain. What am I?
I am a frozen drop that falls in a summer storm. What am I?
I am moving air that you cannot see but can feel. What am I?
I ring when class is over. What am I?
I am a white stick that writes on a board. What am I?
I carry your books on your back. What am I?
I make small writing look big. What am I?
I am a yellow fruit with a peel and I am curved. What am I?
I am red and round and you can crunch me. What am I?
I am a vegetable with layers and I can make you cry. What am I?
I am yellow, with kernels in rows. What am I?
I have holes and I drain your noodles. What am I?
I stir the soup and I am not a fork. What am I?
I am the red planet. What am I?
I am the planet with big bright rings. What am I?
I am the biggest planet and I have a great red spot. What am I?
I have a trunk, branches and leaves, and rings inside. What am I?
I am small and brown and grow into a tall oak. What am I?
I am water that falls over the edge of a high rock. What am I?
I am salty, deep and cover most of the Earth. What am I?
I am a tiny thing that needs sun and water to become a plant. What am I?
I am a big mass of ice that moves very slowly. What am I?
I am a green stalk that pandas love to eat. What am I?
I live in a shell on the beach and have claws. What am I?
I have a pointy horn on my head and I am a made-up horse. What am I?
I tell you the time with my shadow. What am I?
I have a needle that always points north. What am I?
I am yellow and orange, crackle and give heat in the fireplace. What am I?
I wake you up in the morning with a loud ring. What am I?
